title: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akira Tennou, an ordinary 35-year-old office worker, is caught up in a failed summoning and wakes in a forest blighted by a cursed black mist. He finds he can banish the curse with the word 'Purify!', healing a giant silver wolf and other intelligent animals who are the forest's rightful rulers. He sets out to purify the land, unaware that his new friends are legendary beasts and spirits.
life_message: Cheerful kindness and cleansing what is corrupted restore a broken world and win true friends.
